purpose: Reusable architecture for bright, scroll-stopping compilation thumbnails.

middle_layer.separation: crisp cutout-like edge, physically grounded, no merging

subject_consistency.grandma_demographic: derive from the actual video; never assume a demographic from the template
prohibited: demographics absent from the actual video

text_overlay.placement: dedicated top band over open background, never over key subjects
text_overlay.readability: large and immediately legible at mobile size

style.energy: bright, eye-catching, vivid, poppy, emotionally exaggerated
style.realism_boundary: subjects believable; packaging more vivid and graphic than the video footage

validation: Visually inspect one approved good thumbnail example before designing.
Confirm the overlay describes the compilation rather than one isolated scene.
Confirm Grandma's appearance matches the actual video demographics.
Confirm exactly one Grandma and the intended number of animals appear.
Confirm the foreground reaction and animal action remain unobstructed.
Confirm text is readable at 120px and avoids faces, animals, and UI safe zones.
Preserve every generated version; never overwrite an earlier candidate.
